business_problem: Boston Dynamics needed a safer and more scalable way for industrial customers to inspect assets and identify anomalies because manual rounds and fixed sensors are costly, risky, and hard to scale across complex sites.
solution_summary: Boston Dynamics partnered with IBM to combine the Spot mobile robot with IBM edge analytics and asset-management software for industrial inspection. Spot carries cameras and sensors through environments that are difficult, noisy, or unsafe for people, collecting telemetry that IBM analytics process directly on the robot rather than sending everything to the cloud. IBM Maximo Application Suite interprets the data, identifies likely anomalies, and can automatically generate work orders with recommended next steps, while IBM Consulting supports implementation for customer environments. Red Hat technology makes the analytics portable across hybrid-cloud deployments, so the joint solution can be rolled out without instrumenting every machine in a facility. By shifting intelligence to a roaming edge device, the architecture reduces cloud-storage requirements, lowers data-movement costs, and helps operators catch issues before they become major outages.

data_flow: Spot gathers images and telemetry from equipment in the field, IBM analytics on the robot process the data at the edge, Maximo interprets anomalies and opens work orders when needed, and maintenance teams act on the resulting insight.
business_outcome: The combined solution lowers inspection risk and cost while helping operators detect problems sooner and keep production assets running longer.
